_comment: E9's generic procedures (EVENTS_FORMAT.md section 7). sight-range answers by the hex's view grade, move times a hex by the party's speed; terrain traits (ATLAS_FORMAT.md) replace travel multipliers. mm uses this file until mm-core has its own. The rolls along the way belong to the E9 thread.

travel.about: Retired by terrain traits (Heph 2026-11-15): time now comes from move with the hex's traverse grade and the party's speed. Answers 1 until the Atlas stops asking.

sight-range.about: Miles seen from a hex, by its view grade (rules.json movement.view_mi).

navigate.label: Navigate to here
navigate.about: Move the party hex by hex along the way, passing time on its clock and stopping where something happens.

move.about: Time for one hex: distance over the party's speed (slowest member's slowest mode, with the hex's traverse grade already applied by the Atlas from rules.json movement). Roll-free, so the Atlas can dry-run it for estimates; the rolls (orient, traverse, hide) run as their own procedures.
